name: _nwr_record
label: NBFM weather-radio record (headless)
description: All-native NBFM receiver that writes demodulated mono voice audio to a WAV. Source -> Channelizer (-> 25 kHz channel) -> FmDemod (NBFM, +/-5 kHz) -> AudioShaper (300-3400 Hz voice band, DC block) -> RealF32Resamp (48 kHz) -> FileAudioSink. Tuned to NOAA weather radio (162.400-162.550 MHz) for a continuous spoken-word corpus; no squelch or NR so the captured audio is the raw demod the reference STT and the Ferrite pipeline both consume in the differential test.
ai_notes: Headless all-native narrowband-FM receiver that writes demodulated mono voice audio to a WAV file. Intended for unattended recording of a continuous-speech NBFM station (NOAA weather radio at 162.4-162.55 MHz) over a defined window; the demod runs entirely on the server with no browser involvement. Not a listen preset: there is no AudioSink so the UI will not play audio while this is loaded. The voice-band shaper plus 48 kHz resample produce a clean WAV suitable for speech-to-text reference transcription.
